social_warning: Must ALWAYS live completely alone. Co-housing adult Syrians will result in severe territorial fighting and death.
cage_minimum_dimensions: 100 x 50 x 50 cm (5,000 cm² unbroken floor space)
cage_notes: Females are notoriously demanding and often require 120x60cm (7,200 cm²+) to satisfy natural roaming urges. Barless enclosures or bars with <= 1cm spacing.
wheel_notes: Must have completely straight spine while running. Anything smaller causes chronic spine deformation.
sand_bath_specs: At least 25 x 15 cm (depth 5cm+). Used for grooming and toilet training.
diet_summary: High protein seed mix (16-19% protein, 5-7% fat), occasional fresh veg, mealworms, sunflower/pumpkin seeds.
diabetes_risk: Low / standard. Occasional fruit safe (once weekly).

origin: Deserts of Central Asia, Mongolia, northern China
social_warning: Historically marketed in pairs; veterinary evidence confirms paired Robos experience acute stress and aggressive pair dissolution upon maturity.
cage_notes: High tank or barless enclosure strongly recommended. Tiny body slips through bars exceeding 6mm. Can run up to 10km per night.
wheel_notes: Must be lightweight with dual bearings so their small body mass can initiate and halt rotation easily.
sand_bath_specs: Massive sand area: Up to 1/3 of the entire enclosure floor space! Sand is their natural habitat substrate.
diet_summary: Small desert seeds (millet, canary seed, sesame, flax), insect protein (mealworms, crickets), herbs.

origin: Steppes of Central Asia, Tuva, Mongolia, northern China
social_warning: Pairs fight viciously as adults. Must be housed alone.
wheel_notes: Prevents curved spine. Solid running track.
diet_summary: STRICTLY LOW-SUGAR. Highly prone to genetic Type 2 Diabetes. Avoid all fruit, carrots, corn, peas, and honey drops. High fiber and insect protein.
diabetes_risk: EXTREMELY HIGH. Strict diabetes watch required.

social_warning: Must live alone. Often hybridized with Campbell's in pet trade.
diet_summary: Low sugar diet. Avoid dried fruits, sweet vegetables, and sugar binders. High protein seed mix with insects.
diabetes_risk: HIGH (especially pet shop hybrids). Treat as diabetes-prone.

origin: Deserts and steppes of northern China and Mongolia
social_warning: Extremely territorial as adults. Solitary living only.
cage_notes: Excellent agile climbers with gripping paws. Enclosure must prevent tall fall hazards with dense clutter and ramps.
diet_summary: Low-sugar seed mix with varied millet sprays, grains, and mealworms.
